text: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. is an insurance brokerage and risk management company whose common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol AJG; its 2026 proxy statement names its 5% stockholders as The Vanguard Group (9.9%), JP Morgan Chase & Co. (7.8%), BlackRock, Inc. (6.9%) and Capital World Investors (5.0%).
short: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. is NYSE-listed; largest holders are asset managers
